name: TouchStone
does: Audits a product, code or URL across eight domains. Lodestone chooses and replaces its models, sets time limits and a spend limit, and turns failures into plain sentences.

name: Inkstone
does: Writes in a company's voice, sourced by default. The first call in each cold serverless function waits for the current model catalogue (about 0.4 s), so a withdrawn model is dropped before it is tried.

name: Fieldstone
does: Its "Free · no key" option: a thinking partner for testers who have no API key. Lodestone swaps out withdrawn models and keeps one slow model from using the whole time budget. A person who brings their own key calls the provider directly, not through Lodestone.

name: Naija Eval
does: An independent, reproducible scorecard for N-ATLaS on Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba, and the first evaluator to publish model-scorecard/1.
runsOn: Measures models offline and publishes the scores Lodestone can order its models by.
